description: One of the three evening sheets in a venue folder is a byte-for-byte copy of the Friday sheet, and a near copy differs by a single character. DISTILL-CANARY-678dd59e

files.README.md:
Fernbrook Screen - front desk folder

The duty coordinator writes the evening sheet before the doors open and
leaves a printed copy at the front desk. Sheets stay in this folder until
the season ends, then they are boxed and sent to the venue office.
